description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A low flared woven bowl contains one blank removable ceramic liner. Side: Its curved side wall meets a narrow bamboo foot ring. Rear: The rear edge exposes the liner lip and tightly bound rim. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
